summary: Frontend-only MVP test of Matrix Aurin. All 5 pages (Home, Library, Kids Universe, Meditation Corner, User Portal) load cleanly, navigation links route correctly, footer renders globally, hero copy exact match, Library search+filter controls render with 8 items, Meditation breath orb animates, Portal Sign In & Register buttons are properly disabled, mobile hamburger reveals all 5 links + Enter Portal CTA. Zero console/page errors across the app.
critical_code_review_comments: Active nav link class check (`aurin-link ... tracking-wide` with no active marker in className) — NavLink active state only toggles the muted-text class conditionally; there is no distinct underline/color applied for the active state on desktop nav. Works (isActive removes the muted color), but visually subtle. Consider adding an explicit active indicator for clarity.
Home.jsx line 123: testid `home-stat-${s.k.toLowerCase()}` uses 'Future' which has value 'Guided by AI' — fine, but keys aren't enumerated in the review request spec; non-blocking.
Footer 'Sign In' and 'Register' links both route to /portal (same as User Portal link) — acceptable placeholder behavior but three identical destinations in Account column feels redundant.
No 404/NotFound route in App.js — any unmatched URL will render blank Layout. Low priority for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (51/51 real assertions; 3 script-side counting errors in my test, not app bugs — item selector used wrong dash count)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Library item testids follow pattern `library-item-gp-01`, `library-item-gp-02`... with child testids `-access` and `-open`. When counting items, match exact prefix-only nodes (query `[data-testid^='library-item-gp-']:not([data-testid$='-access']):not([data-testid$='-open'])`). Hero copy verified exactly: 'A quiet place to remember who you are.' All 8 items render, 5 filters present, mobile menu at <1024px shows hamburger. Backend was not tested (frontend-only request).
verified_flows: Home page hero + 4 layer cards + AI status chip
Nav → Library → Kids Universe → Meditation Corner → User Portal routing
Library search input + 5 filter tabs render (All/book/protocol/audio/video)
Portal: Sign In and Register buttons have disabled=true
Footer site-footer + footer-copy on every page
Mobile (390x844): hamburger toggles menu with all 5 links + Enter Portal
